script: Most creators burn out because their workflow is broken. A good system turns one long recording into many short pieces. Start small: one script, one video, three clips.

sections.text: Most creators burn out because their workflow is broken, not because they are lazy.
A good system turns one long recording into many short pieces of content.
Start small: one script, one video, three clips, and publish consistently.

clips.title: Why most creators burn out
clips.hook: You're not lazy. Your workflow is broken.
clips.caption: Burnout is a systems problem, not a motivation problem.
clips.reason: Strongest emotional moment, matches script paragraph 1

clips.title: One recording, many clips
clips.hook: Stop recording ten videos. Record one.
clips.caption: Turn a single long video into a week of content.
clips.reason: Clear, actionable tip that matches script paragraph 2

clips.title: Start small
clips.hook: Three clips. One video. Start today.
clips.caption: Consistency beats perfection, start with one script and one video.
clips.reason: Strong call to action, matches script paragraph 3
